scope: Upstream mixed C/Fortran FPM library, with a checksum-guarded manifest edit adding its src/inc header directory. The X11 link dependency is retained but the checked main uses the PPM file driver, requiring no display server or Hershey font files. A 20-segment blue parabola is rendered with the PPM driver; the consumer checks P3 magic, image dimensions, color range, every pixel range and the presence of blue curve pixels. The ordinary image collector converts the generated PPM to a bounded PNG browser preview. The SVG driver aborted during font initialization when no Hershey fonts were supplied; no upstream driver code is patched, and the example uses PPM. Interactive drivers, all drawing primitives, software text/font setup and SVG output are not validated.
known_limitations: The SVG driver aborts during font initialization without a Hershey font. The verified example uses PPM.
The PPM driver clears its raster to black, irrespective of the selected clear color.
license_notes: Upstream root LICENSE is Unlicense and implementation headers identify public-domain code; the upstream FPM manifest labels the package MIT. Root license and representative source notices are retained.
